title: User admin autofill off; password history LIMIT fix; profile list facets; minimum profile age 18; profile E2E coverage expansion; docs (Composer/mPDF, migration 011, seeders map, QA matrix)
summary: PasswordPolicy::validateForUser() no longer binds LIMIT as a PDO placeholder (MySQL 1064 when the driver quotes the limit). Users add/edit form sets autocomplete hints to reduce browser/password-manager interference. Profile list: facet filters (project, field personnel, barangay, age min/max, date of invitation range, PAPSID, control number) with project-scope enforcement; same filter query keys apply to GET /api/profile/list via Profile::parseListFiltersFromRequest. Profile create/edit/import and REST store/update validate minimum age 18 (Profile::MINIMUM_PROFILE_AGE, validateMinimumAgeInput); birthday date input max on web form reflects that rule. Earlier list-only birthday range filters were removed in favor of invitation-date facets and age bounds. Profile automation now includes pending QA sections for Export/PDF and Security/Negative scenarios, plus full admin show_deleted matrix coverage (`active`, `with`, `only`). Developer docs: README setup adds composer install for mPDF; structure tree documents database/seeders/; DEVELOPMENTGUIDE notes dual migration_011* files and PdfExport; FrameworksGuide seeder list includes seed_profiles.php; CHANGES.md documents the doc pass; AUTOMATED_FUNCTIONAL_TEST_DESIGN.md now includes a QA-to-automation coverage matrix.

items: validateForUser: use capped integer LIMIT in SQL string instead of bound ? (PDO+MySQL can emit LIMIT 'N' and SQLSTATE 1064); error message uses same effective limit
Form autocomplete=off; username/display/email autocomplete=off; password autocomplete=new-password; role/project selects autocomplete=off; project Select2 data-lpignore and data-1p-ignore

App/Models/Profile.php: parseListFiltersFromRequest() for project_id, field_personnel_id, barangay, age_min/age_max, date_of_invitation_from/to, papsid, control_number; listPaginated applies facet SQL
App/Controllers/ProfileController.php: builds listFilters for index, export, and PDF list scopes; projectsForProfileFilters / fieldPersonnelForProfileFilters for dropdowns
App/Controllers/Api/ProfileController.php: listApi passes $_GET through parseListFiltersFromRequest with UserProjects::allowedProjectIds()
App/Views/profile/index.php: filter card form (GET) + show_deleted for admins
App/Models/Profile.php: MINIMUM_PROFILE_AGE = 18; validateMinimumAgeInput() for age and/or birthday
App/Controllers/ProfileController.php store/update: server-side validation before save
App/Controllers/Api/ProfileController.php storeApi/updateApi: same validation on JSON bodies
App/Views/profile/form.php: age min and birthday max attributes tied to MINIMUM_PROFILE_AGE; helper text
List UI: removed dedicated birthday-from/to filters (use invitation dates and age min/max instead)
